chapter: Leaving the band, Strayhorn and reflections
title: Duke's scar and Mercer Ellington's book
summary: Greer rejects Mercer's story and says he knew every woman Duke saw; he can't say how Duke got the scar.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: I was going to ask you, now you know -- do you recall how Ellington got that scar he had on his face? Like in Mercer's book --
What did Mercer say?
Well, Ellington had three or four stories. He had one in the book.
What did Duke say?
Oh, he gave three different stories. None of them had anything to do with any women.
No, the scar?
Yeah.
What'd he say, how he got that?
Well, he'd say, I think he said he fell down, he was shaving, I don't remember the stories. But --
That's wrong. That's wrong. Now, what did Mercer say?
Mercer says -- let me see, Mercer says it was done by a jealous woman.

No, it wasn't done by no jealous woman. Who done it, I don't recall now. No jealous woman did that to him. No way. And Mercer, Mercer was -- you know, me and my wife, we practically raised Mercer. Mercer was a kid. He don't -- I don't care what he wrote, he wasn't big enough to dig something like that. And I've never read his book but he lost a lot of friends when he wrote that book. I never heard it. Everybody in our club, Duke Ellington Jazz Society, put him down. I'd put him down, and my being like a father to him. My wife practically raised him. He never
was around our band that much. How can he write about our band, because he wasn't around us. No, he wasn't. He was off somewhere, in Juilliard School somewhere. He never was around there.
But you don't recall how Ellington actually got the cut?
No. That's so many years ago, I don't know. I really don't know.
I think Mercer said it had something to do with Ellington and some women.

No. I knew all the women Duke fooled with. None of them cut him. No, that's false. No way. He was like a brother to me, he knows Duke and I -- he'd tell you that. If he had a brother, it would be Sonny Greer.
Yeah, that's true. He said that many times. That's odd, you know, you don't recall that.
No, I would have recalled some incident like that. I would have been there.
But, I mean, that's quite a large cut he had, it wasn't a small --
I can't verify how it happened but as far as I know, like I say, I don't know.
